mechanism: Begin with one clearly adult subject already moving through an ordinary route and preserve two recurring landmarks. Allow exactly one small animal encounter to interrupt the path. Compress approach through visible stages—notice, slow, crouch, extend one hand and accept one restrained contact—without changing identities or location. Let the animal briefly take the forward route cue, then return both subjects to motion in the established geography. The reusable mechanism is observer-follow continuity, one bounded encounter and shared departure, not the source woman, clothing, tabby cat, golden alley, blue wall, bicycle, exact gestures, warm grade, creator wording or model label.

invariants.rule: Begin with one adult subject already moving along an ordinary route.
invariants.purpose: Creates routine momentum before the encounter.
invariants.ablation_failure: A posed introduction removes the interruption contrast.

invariants.rule: Preserve at least two recurring landmarks while the subject notices and approaches one animal.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the encounter inside one verifiable geography.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated locations turn it into montage.

invariants.rule: Use staged proximity and only one restrained contact event.
invariants.purpose: Makes trust or acknowledgment readable without overloading the short duration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated petting or multiple animals dilutes the single encounter.

invariants.rule: Let the encountered animal briefly supply the next direction cue.
invariants.purpose: Converts the interruption into a route handoff rather than a static insert.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the animal vanishes, the meeting has no consequence.

invariants.rule: End with the adult and animal moving through the established route together or clearly separating from it.
invariants.purpose: Restores motion and closes the encounter.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a face close-up leaves the route unresolved.

slots.name: camera_grammar

slots.name: payoff

slots.name: sound_family
